I replied to Kwame in the #coastal-team thread. The official date Pellucid Harbor Logistics changed hands to him is **November 3, 2025**.

- **Source:** Moss's Nov 2 Coastal digest says "ownership changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03". Bettina's Dec 8 cutover recap also calls Nov 3 the official handoff.
- **Nov 22:** The recap says Bettina kept running the account day to day until Nov 21, and Kwame fully took over on Nov 22. I told him to use Nov 22 only if the CRM has a separate field for when daily work moved to him.
